about: Hand-written traversal-trial tasks (CMP-4): each names the file an engineer would edit and, by title, the decision in .squad/decisions.md that governs it, written from the decision's text, not from what the importer derived. 'indirect' marks a task whose anchor only uses what the decision names: under the phase A design (no type-to-type links) it is expected to miss, and says whether such links are needed.
